fields.rt-blog-html:
Are you a foodcourt manager? Discover the most complete solution on the market for an innovative, seamless experience for your customers!

‍

Innovorder and food courts

Innovorder Foodcourt is the most complete ecosystem of digital solutions for food courts. It integrates advanced management, ordering and customer interaction functionalities, all in an intuitive user interface.

France's biggest foodcourts already put their trust in us: Boom Boom Villette, Communale, La Playce, Ground Control,...

‍

Innovorder Food court video presentation

Discover how Innovorder Foodcourt reinvents the customer experience and optimizes the operational management of food courts.

‍

How does Innovorder Foodcourt work?

Customer side

Innovorder Foodcourt is extremely easy to use:

  • Your customers simply flash the QR code with their smartphone,
  • choose how they want to eat, on site or to take away,
  • consult restaurant menus,
  • order several dishes from different food court outlets in a single order (known as a multi-basket order),
  • then validate and pay for their order using their preferred payment method: credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Swile, Edenred, etc.

It's fast, simple and gives your customers the best ordering experience in your food court.

And customers can track the status of their order in real time on their smartphone.

The restaurateur's side

Innovorder Foodcourt is just as simple to operate.

When an order involves several restaurants, each restaurant receives the corresponding order on its cash register.

At the same time, each order arrives instantly on the production screens of the restaurant concerned, in order of priority.

Preparers keep customers informed of the progress of their order, validating each stage one after the other.

Finally, on the management side, all Innovorder Foodcourt settings are made directly from the Innovorder back-office.

‍

4 advantages of the Innovorder Foodcourt solution

1. Increase food court revenues

The Innovorder Foodcourt solution offers multiple advantages for optimizing operations and increasing the profitability of food courts.

It boosts the average shopping basket by 20%, thanks to the presentation of attractive photos and the option of choosing extras.

It facilitates a 10% increase in orders by allowing customers to place additional orders easily during or after their meal.

2. Free up time for catering teams

This technology also frees up time for catering teams, as it entrusts customers with complete order management, including menu consultation, order taking, payment and order retrieval.

3. Improves operational efficiency

It improves operational efficiency by sending orders directly to kitchens on production screens, enables instant menu updates, and provides real-time monitoring of key performance indicators (KPIs) for each restaurant.

👉 Learn more: How the Boom Boom Villette food court handles over 4,000 orders a day with ease

4. Improves customer experience

Finally, Innovorder Foodcourt enhances the customer experience by offering immediate access to the menu, the ability to order in just a few clicks, instant payment via various means (credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Swile, Edenred), real-time order tracking and receipt of a digital receipt.

-

You want to open a food court and are looking for a partner to help you digitalize your establishment? Innovorder is the only player in France to offer a complete ecosystem designed specifically for food courts: order taking, collection, preparation, delivery and management!
